manifest.name: bkx config precedence fix overlay
manifest.description: Fixes BKX config layering so local config files reliably override environment variables, including lean environments without PyYAML.
notes: This is a follow-up for repos where bkx_shared_interactive_tui_172612_overlay.zip already applied.
No TUI behavior changes; this fixes a pre-existing core config loader bug exposed by full validation.
The fallback parser intentionally supports BKX's scalar key/value config surface, not full YAML.
